# Support

Maintained on a best-effort basis — no uptime guarantee, no response-time
promise, and no official ELTE support.

## Before asking for help

1. Check the [user guide](../docs/user-guide.md).
2. Confirm the subject code in Neptun or another official ELTE system.
3. Try the same thing with `DEMO-1` through `DEMO-6`. If DEMO works, the
   problem is probably missing live Tanrend data.
4. Search existing issues for the same problem.

## Bugs

Use the bug-report form. Include the steps, what you expected, what happened,
your browser and OS, and a DEMO code if one works. Clean screenshots and logs
first — no credentials, private share links, or personal schedule info.

A bug that reproduces with a `DEMO-*` subject is usually fixed faster.

## Feature requests

Use the feature-request form: the problem, the outcome you want, and whether
it touches saved schedules, shared URLs, conflicts, calendar dates, or Tanrend.

## Security reports

Don't open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability — follow
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) so it can be reviewed privately.

## Course-data questions

This project shows Tanrend data but doesn't control it. Confirm times, rooms,
instructors, and availability in official ELTE systems — the maintainer can't
fix university records.
